signIn.intro: SNS Rent a Car · Elpitiya. Sign in to your account.
signIn.help: Forgot your password? Ask the owner to reset it. 5 wrong tries lock the account for 15 minutes.
signIn.everyone: Owner, admin, staff and partners each have their own account.
signIn.wrong: The phone number or the password is wrong.
signIn.locked: The account is locked after 5 wrong tries. Try again in 15 minutes.
signIn.phoneInvalid: This is not a Sri Lankan mobile number. Type the 10 digits, starting 070, 071, 072, 074, 075, 076, 077 or 078.
signIn.passwordShort: Passwords have at least 8 characters. Check what you typed.

firstSignIn.title: Your password
firstSignIn.subtitle: First sign-in
firstSignIn.intro: This is your first sign-in. Choose your own password to replace the one you were given.
firstSignIn.rule: At least 8 characters. If you forget it, the owner resets it.
firstSignIn.notSame: The two passwords are not the same.

settings.title: Settings
settings.peopleNote: Nobody shares an account. Every action is saved under the name of the person signed in, even though staff share one cash drawer. When someone leaves, open their row and turn the account off, with a reason: sign-in stops, and their name stays on everything they recorded.
settings.partnersLater: Partner owners get their account when they are added on Partners.

add.title: Add a person
add.name: Name
add.passwordHint: You type it and give it to the person by hand. They change it at their first sign-in.
add.adminHint: Approvals and partner cash-outs by default
add.partnerHint: Added with the partner, on Partners: one account for all their cars
add.defaultsHint: You can change them for this person after saving, on the Permissions page.
add.footer: Give the first password to the person by hand; nothing is sent. Saving is recorded in the activity log.

person.ownerNote: The primary owner can do everything. The owner's own password is reset by email (coming later).
person.resetHint: When {name} forgets the password. They are signed out everywhere and change it at their next sign-in.
person.newPasswordHint: You type it and give it to {name} by hand. At least 8 characters.
person.resetDone: Done. Give the new first password to {name} by hand.
person.offHint: When {name} leaves. Sign-in stops at once. Everything {name} recorded keeps the name. You can turn it back on.
person.onHint: Turning it back on lets {name} sign in again with the same password.
person.logNote: Every change is recorded in the activity log.

permissionsPage.lock: Only the primary owner can change these, add people or turn accounts off; those three cannot be given to anyone. The owner can do everything and is not listed.
permissionsPage.authorisedHint: Not set yet: only the owner until given to someone.
permissionsPage.selfApproval: Nobody approves their own request; another approver must. The owner's own is marked "self-approved".
permissionsPage.noPeople: No admin or staff yet. Add people first.

errors.phoneInvalid: This is not a Sri Lankan mobile number. Type the 10 digits, starting 070, 071, 072, 074, 075, 076, 077 or 078.
errors.phoneTaken: Someone already has this phone number.
errors.reasonMissing: Write why the account is turned off.
errors.notAllowed: Only the primary owner can do this.
